imitate one's accent: My younger sister loves to imitate my accent after I come home from studying in London.
我從倫敦留學回家後，妹妹很喜歡模仿我的口音。
imitate nature: Many engineers try to imitate nature, such as designing fast trains whose shape looks like a bird's beak.
許多工程師試著模仿自然，例如設計出外型像鳥嘴的高速列車。
art imitates life: People often say that art imitates life, because many great novels are based on the writers' real experiences.
人們常說藝術模仿人生，因為許多偉大的小說都是以作家的真實經歷為基礎。
impact the economy: The long typhoon season could seriously impact the economy, especially farming and tourism in the south.
漫長的颱風季可能嚴重衝擊經濟，尤其是南部的農業和觀光業。
impact on sales: The new advertisement on social media had a huge impact on sales, which doubled within a single month.
社群媒體上的新廣告對銷售產生了巨大影響，銷售額在一個月內就翻倍。
positively impact: Studies show that getting enough sleep can positively impact your memory and your grades at school.
研究顯示，充足的睡眠能正面影響你的記憶力和在校成績。
impact lives: Volunteers at the center hope their small acts of kindness will impact lives in a meaningful way.
中心的志工們希望他們小小的善舉能以有意義的方式影響人們的生活。
implement a policy: The city began to implement a new policy last month, and now all shops must charge for plastic bags.
市政府上個月開始實施一項新政策，現在所有商店都必須對塑膠袋收費。
implement changes: After reading the students' complaints, the school decided to implement changes to the lunch menu.
看了學生的抱怨後，學校決定對午餐菜單落實改變。
implement a plan: We need more money and more volunteers to implement a plan as large as cleaning the whole beach.
我們需要更多經費和志工，才能執行像清理整片海灘這麼大的計畫。
implement reforms: The new president promised to implement reforms that would make the tax system fairer for ordinary families.
新總統承諾推行改革，讓稅制對一般家庭更公平。
imply criticism: Her teacher's comment, "Interesting choice of words," seemed to imply criticism of her essay rather than praise.
老師那句「用字選擇很有趣」似乎暗含對她作文的批評，而不是稱讚。
imply that: When he kept looking at his watch, he seemed to imply that the meeting was taking too long.
他一直看手錶，似乎在暗示會議開得太久了。
rights imply duties: Our civics teacher reminded us that rights imply duties, so voting is a responsibility as well as a freedom.
公民老師提醒我們權利意味義務，所以投票既是自由也是責任。
an implied threat: His words sounded polite, but there was an implied threat in them that made everyone in the room nervous.
他的話聽起來很有禮貌，但其中隱含的威脅讓房間裡每個人都很緊張。
impose a tax: The government decided to impose a tax on sugary drinks to encourage people to eat more healthily.
政府決定對含糖飲料課稅，以鼓勵人們吃得更健康。
impose one's views on: Good parents listen to their children instead of trying to impose their views on them all the time.
好的父母會傾聽孩子的想法，而不是總想把自己的看法強加於他們身上。
impose a fine: The city will impose a fine on anyone who throws trash on the street or lets their dog make a mess.
市政府將對任何在街上亂丟垃圾或讓狗隨地便溺的人處以罰款。
impose restrictions: Because of the drought, the city had to impose restrictions on water use, and officials will check every week.
由於乾旱，市政府必須對用水施加限制，而且官員每週都會檢查。
impose on someone's kindness: You've already helped me so much, and I don't want to impose on your kindness by staying another night.
你已經幫了我很多，我不想再多住一晚而占你的好意便宜。
impress the interviewer: To impress the interviewer, Amy arrived early, dressed neatly, and answered every question with confidence.
為了給面試官好印象，艾咪提早到達、穿著整齊，並且自信地回答每個問題。
impress upon someone the importance: Our coach always tried to impress upon us the importance of warming up before every game.
我們的教練總是努力讓我們牢記每場比賽前暖身的重要性。
be impressed by: Visitors from abroad are often impressed by how clean and convenient the city's subway system is.
外國遊客常對這座城市捷運系統的乾淨與便利印象深刻。
incorporate feedback: The designers will incorporate feedback from users to make the next version of the app easier to use.
設計師們會納入使用者的回饋，讓下一版的應用程式更容易使用。
incorporate new ideas: Our team leader encourages us to incorporate new ideas into our project instead of copying last year's work.
我們的組長鼓勵我們在專題中融入新點子，而不是照抄去年的作品。
incorporate a company: The two friends decided to incorporate a company after their online shop became more successful than expected.
在網路商店比預期更成功之後，這兩位朋友決定成立公司。
incorporate into the design: The architect managed to incorporate solar panels into the design of the school's new library.
建築師成功地把太陽能板融入學校新圖書館的設計中。
induce sleep: A warm glass of milk and some soft music may help induce sleep after a long, stressful day.
在漫長又有壓力的一天之後，一杯溫牛奶和輕柔的音樂可能有助於引發睡意。
induce labor: Since the baby was already two weeks late, the doctor decided to induce labor at the hospital.
由於寶寶已經晚了兩週，醫生決定在醫院催生。
induce someone to buy: Shops use tricks like big "50% off" signs to induce customers to buy things they never planned to get.
商店使用像大大的「五折」標誌這類手法，誘使顧客購買他們原本沒打算買的東西。
induce vomiting: If a child swallows something poisonous, do not try to induce vomiting before calling a doctor for advice.
如果孩子吞下有毒物質，在打電話問醫生之前，不要試圖催吐。
